content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Billboards, broadband and insurance brokerage differ from News Corp's news, books and property listing portals."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Out-of-home advertising displays sell ad space, unlike News Corp's news publishing, subscriptions and property portals."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Ad-funded lifestyle and affiliate publishing lacks News Corp's news, business data, book and property listing businesses."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Financial management and tax software for businesses and consumers, not news publishing or property listings."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Local newspapers selling subscriptions and advertising, including to real estate firms, closely match News Corp's newspaper and subscription model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sports and lifestyle magazines monetised through sponsored content and affiliate links, not news, data or property services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Radio and cable broadcasting sells airtime, a different business from News Corp's print, digital news and property platforms."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Tech and gaming media combined with cybersecurity and speed-testing software differs from News Corp's news and property businesses."}]}
